title: the sudo relay case-fold tooth compares output with the clock removed
intention: system_word's relay tooth compares `cairn sudorelay --status` against `--STATUS` with every ISO timestamp taken out, so the tooth stops being a coin toss on the second turning over.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 by the orchestrator's Linux reseal: test_system_word.py:340 test_sudo_relay_takes_uppercase_status_flag red, outputs stamped 00:29:29 against 00:29:30. This blocks 85848910db3a and 6f2fb0aec8dc.
traces_to: Law 3 (a proof that flips on the clock measures the clock, not the fold); Law 8 (a hollow-free green must be repeatable).
how: test_system_word.py gains _untimed(text), a regex replacing every ISO timestamp, and test_sudo_relay_takes_uppercase_status_flag compares stdout and stderr through it. A new declaring proof checks _untimed equates clock-only differences and keeps word differences, and that the relay tooth compares through it and passes.

clauses.claim: test_system_word._untimed makes two lines differing only in their ISO timestamp equal, and two lines differing in their words unequal

decisions.text: D1: _untimed and its regex in test_system_word.py; the relay tooth compares through it.
D2: the declaring proof, one tooth per clause, loading test_system_word.py by path.

out: every other tooth of test_system_word.py, including the harbor_master one
